settings.title: Details & materials
settings.content: Adaptive open-cell memory foam core · CloudCool™ phase-change gel layer · removable Tencel™ lyocell cover. CertiPUR-US® certified. Dual-height: 4.5" / 5.5". Hypoallergenic and dust-mite resistant.

settings.title: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Free 2-day shipping on orders over $75. Ships within 24 hours. Sleep on it for 100 nights — if you don't love it, we'll arrange a free return and full refund.

settings.title: Care instructions
settings.content: Unzip and machine wash the Tencel cover cold, tumble dry low. Spot clean the foam core only — do not submerge.

settings.title: Aligns your spine
settings.text: Contoured cervical ridge keeps your neck neutral all night.

settings.title: Stays cool
settings.text: CloudCool™ gel holds the surface ~4°C cooler than memory foam.

settings.title: Flips to fit
settings.text: Dual-height design — one side for side sleepers, one for back.

settings.title: Built to last
settings.text: Holds its loft for 5+ years, backed by our warranty.

settings.question: How does the 100-night trial work?
settings.answer: Sleep on it for 100 nights. If it's not the best pillow you've owned, we'll arrange a free return and full refund.

settings.question: Which firmness should I pick?
settings.answer: Medium suits most sleepers. Soft for stomach sleepers, Firm for broad-shouldered side sleepers.
